Modifications: bounded-resolution selection; OpenGL normal maps to PNG; roughness inverted to smoothness in alpha with metallic in red; alpha packed into albedo where provided; supplied lower rock LODs selected and decimated; one complete floodlight fixture selected; bottom-centre metre pivots; Unity URP materials/simple box colliders generated by the project editor builder. Assets do not grant gameplay food/power or simulate equipment.
